metadata.name: CropGuard AI — Precision Agronomy Interventions
metadata.source: ICAR / State Agriculture Dept / RBK Field Data

yield_thresholds.note: Fraction of crop baseline yield. Below critical → red alert + full intervention package

N_low.symptom: Yellowing of older leaves (chlorosis), stunted growth
N_low.remedy: Apply Urea @ 45 kg/acre as top-dressing. Split into 2 doses: basal + 30-day.

P_low.symptom: Dark green to purplish leaves, poor root development
P_low.remedy: Apply Single Super Phosphate (SSP) @ 30 kg P₂O₅/acre at transplanting

K_low.symptom: Leaf tip burning (scorch), weak stems, poor grain filling
K_low.remedy: Apply MOP (Muriate of Potash) @ 25 kg K₂O/acre

high_temp.remedy: Evening irrigation to reduce canopy temp. Plant heat-tolerant variety (MTU-7029).

low_rainfall.remedy: Activate SRI (System of Rice Intensification) — AWD (Alternate Wetting & Drying). Apply anti-transpirant (Kaolin 5%) foliar spray.

N_low.symptom: Pale yellowing from older leaves upward
N_low.remedy: Apply Urea @ 40 kg/acre. Split 50% basal + 50% at crown root initiation stage.

high_temp.remedy: Terminal heat stress — irrigate at boot stage. Use heat-tolerant variety (K-307, GW-322).

low_rainfall.remedy: Critical irrigations: CRI (Crown Root Initiation), tillering, and grain filling stages.

N_low.symptom: V-shaped yellowing from leaf tip toward midrib on lower leaves
N_low.remedy: Urea @ 50 kg/acre. Apply in 3 splits: basal, 30-day, 45-day.

K_low.symptom: Leaf margin necrosis, poor ear development

high_temp.remedy: Foliar spray of Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 2% during silking stage.

low_rainfall.remedy: Drip irrigation (critical at VT + R1 stage). Mulching with crop residue.

pest_interventions.chemical: Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L into whorl

P_low.symptom: Poor root growth, dark green foliage turning purple

K_low.symptom: Interveinal chlorosis, premature boll shedding (Boll retention problem)
K_low.remedy: MOP @ 35 kg/acre + foliar KNO₃ @ 1.5% at flowering

high_temp.remedy: Anti-transpirant spray (Kaolin 5%). Irrigate at flower bud initiation.

low_rainfall.remedy: Drip irrigation with fertigation. Mulching to conserve soil moisture.

pest_interventions.chemical: Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1 g/L (rotate with Spiromesifen 22.9 SC)
pest_interventions.bio: Yellow sticky traps @ 8/acre + neem oil 5% spray

N_low.symptom: Light green to yellow older leaves, reduced tillering
N_low.remedy: Urea @ 75 kg/acre. Apply in 3 splits across growing season.

K_low.symptom: Reddening of leaves, poor juice quality
K_low.remedy: MOP @ 50 kg/acre + SOP (Sulphate of Potash) for quality cane

high_temp.remedy: Drip irrigation with micro-climate cooling. Trash mulching.

low_rainfall.remedy: Deficit irrigation scheduling: irrigate at 50% available soil moisture depletion.

pest_interventions.bio: Trichogramma chilonis + release of Cotesia flavipes parasitoid

N_low.remedy: Rhizobium + PSB seed inoculation. Foliar urea 1% at 30 DAS if no nodulation.

P_low.symptom: Poor pod development, reduced oil content
P_low.remedy: SSP @ 30 kg/acre + gypsum @ 200 kg/acre at pegging stage

high_temp.remedy: Mulching + irrigation at critical stages (flowering, pegging, pod filling).

low_rainfall.remedy: Sprinkler irrigation. Anti-transpirant spray at pod filling.

pest_interventions.bio: Trichoderma viride seed treatment @ 4 g/kg seed
